Article Title: 'Dream come true': Mikel Merino eyes FIFA World Cup 2026 glory after firing Spain into semifinals
Article Text:
Mikel Merino (AP Photo)

Merino shines again as super-sub



'Two matches to win a World Cup'



Mikel Merino said Spain are just two wins away from achieving a "dream come true" after his late goal helped La Roja beat Belgium 2-1 and book a place in the FIFA World Cup 2026 semifinals.Merino once again made a big impact after coming off the bench. The Arsenal midfielder scored the winning goal in the 88th minute, sending Spain into the last four, where they will face tournament favourites France.Merino had also been Spain's hero in the previous round, scoring a stoppage-time winner as a substitute in the 1-0 victory over Portugal. Against Belgium, he came on in the 86th minute and found the net with just his second touch.He reacted quickest after Belgium goalkeeper Senne Lammens spilled Pau Cubarsí's powerful long-range shot, tapping home the rebound to seal Spain's place in the semifinals.Speaking after the match, Merino was delighted to once again make the difference for his team."It seems like a coincidence, and if you go in prepared, it can happen again. I'm thrilled. I doubt it will happen again, we'll see," Merino said after his match-winning exploits, as quoted by FIFA.With Spain now just one step away from the final, Merino admitted the team is dreaming of lifting the trophy."Two matches to win a World Cup is a dream come true - hopefully we can achieve it," he added.Spain overcome Belgium challengeSpain took the lead in the 30th minute through Fabián Ruiz, but Belgium hit back before half-time when Charles De Ketelaere scored the first goal Spain had conceded in the entire tournament.Belgium suffered a setback in the 71st minute when goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois was forced off with an apparent thigh injury. Backup goalkeeper Senne Lammens replaced him but could not prevent Merino's late winner.Belgium pushed hard for an equaliser in the closing stages, but Spain held firm to secure a 2-1 victory.Spain will now take on France in a blockbuster semifinal.
Article Summary: Spain beat Belgium 2-1 to reach the FIFA World Cup 2026 semifinals. Mikel Merino scored the winning goal in the 88th minute against Belgium. The Arsenal midfielder also scored a stoppage-time winner in the previous round. Spain will now face France in a blockbuster semifinal.

Article Title: Only TWO ever made! Cristiano Ronaldo stuns IShowSpeed with his rarest and most personal gift yet
Article Text:
Cristiano Ronaldo gifts IShowSpeed his game-worn World Cup boots after Portugal's FIFA World Cup exit/ Image: X

A special gift after Portugal's early exit

Why the boots are so significant





A fitting gift for one of Ronaldo's biggest supporters

Cristiano Ronaldo has gifted streamer IShowSpeed one of the most exclusive pieces of memorabilia from the FIFA World Cup 2026, sending him the game-worn Nike Mercurial Superfly 11 "CR7 Gold Scorpion" boots he wore during what is widely expected to be the final World Cup campaign of his international career.The emotional moment unfolded live during IShowSpeed's watchalong of Spain's quarter-final victory over Belgium, when the YouTube star opened a package from Ronaldo and discovered the gold boots inside. Visibly stunned, Speed was told he now owned one of only two pairs of the limited-edition boots produced by Nike.According to reports, Ronaldo had originally intended to hand the boots to IShowSpeed in person if Portugal had progressed to the World Cup quarter-finals.However, those plans changed after Portugal's tournament came to an end with a 1-0 defeat to Spain in the Round of 16, a match that also marked Ronaldo's final appearance at a FIFA World Cup.Rather than abandoning the idea, the Portugal captain reportedly ensured the boots were shipped directly to one of his biggest supporters instead.The delivery came while Speed was livestreaming Spain's quarter-final against Belgium on Friday, creating one of the most memorable off-field moments of the tournament.Having been left heartbroken by Portugal's elimination earlier in the week, Speed reacted with visible emotion as he carefully unboxed the gift before showing the boots to his audience.The boots are not standard match footwear. They belong to Nike's limited-edition Mercurial Superfly 11 "CR7 Gold Scorpion" collection, a special release created to celebrate Ronaldo becoming the first men's player to score in six different FIFA World Cup tournaments.Unlike commercially available versions, these were the actual boots worn by Ronaldo during Portugal's 2026 World Cup campaign, making them authentic match-used memorabilia from one of football's most decorated players.Their significance has only grown following Portugal's elimination, with the tournament now expected to stand as Ronaldo's final World Cup appearance.According to those present during the unboxing, only two pairs of the "CR7 Gold Scorpion" boots exist, further adding to their rarity.IShowSpeed has built a reputation as one of Ronaldo's most passionate public supporters, regularly celebrating the Portugal captain across his livestreams and social media platforms.Throughout the World Cup, Speed closely followed Portugal's campaign and reacted live to their matches, making little secret of his hope that Ronaldo could end his World Cup career with another deep tournament run.That journey ended against Spain in the Round of 16, preventing the anticipated quarter-final meeting with Belgium that many had expected.Instead, Spain advanced before defeating Belgium 2-1 to reach the semi-finals, while Ronaldo's tournament concluded sooner than planned.Although Portugal's campaign ended in disappointment, Ronaldo ensured one lasting memory emerged from it by sending a personal piece of World Cup history to one of his most devoted fans. Rather than remaining in his own collection, the game-worn "CR7 Gold Scorpion" boots found a new home with the streamer whose admiration for the five-time Ballon d'Or winner has become a defining part of his online identity.
Article Summary: Cristiano Ronaldo sends IShowSpeed his game-worn World Cup boots. The Portugal captain sent the boots after Portugal's early World Cup exit. The boots are one of only two pairs of the Nike Mercurial Superfly 11 "CR7 Gold Scorpion" boots.

Article Title: World Cup 2026: FIFA puts World Cup final pitch up for sale at a whopping Rs. 42,989 per piece
Article Text:
FIFA is marketing pieces of World Cup final turf for USD 450, but the initiative has sparked outrage from both fans and players. The turf's poor quality has come under fire for its irregular texture.(AP Photo)

Football’s global governing body, FIFA, has decided to commercialise the very ground the players will walk on for the World Cup final. FIFA is now selling individual pieces of the grass turf that will be used for the upcoming World Cup final at the MetLife Stadium in New Jersey for a staggering USD 450 (approx. Rs. 42,989) per piece.Already facing severe backlash for charging exorbitant ticket prices for the tournament in the United States, FIFA's latest merchandise strategy has added fuel to the fire. The official FIFA digital store states that each segment of the turf measures 17.5 by 17.5 by 17.5, though the listing bizarrely fails to specify whether the dimensions are in inches, centimetres, or millimetres.Promoted as a premium piece of football history, FIFA's website states that each original fragment of the July 19 final playing surface will come permanently preserved inside a high-end acrylic case. To entice collectors, the package includes a sleek USB keepsake containing an authenticity film, all presented inside a luxury hinged shoulder box with striking spot UV detailing.However, ordinary fans outside Western markets will miss out, as FIFA has restricted shipping exclusively to addresses within the United States and Europe. The governing body has also clarified that no orders will be dispatched until after the final whistle of the tournament.The decision to sell the turf comes wrapped in controversy. The MetLife Stadium, home to the NFL's New York Giants and Jets, usually features an artificial surface. FIFA laid down temporary natural grass for this tournament, which has drawn sharp criticism from players and managers alike over its poor quality and uneven texture.The steep ₹42,989 price tag for a patch of grass aligns with the unprecedented ticket inflation seen in this edition. Standard tickets for the grand finale are being retailed for up to USD 32,970 (approx. ₹31.4 lakh), while premium hospitality packages including food and drinks are priced between USD 32,500 (approx. ₹31 lakh) and USD 34,500 (approx. ₹32.9 lakh).
Article Summary: FIFA is selling individual pieces of the grass turf that will be used for the upcoming World Cup final at the MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. The turf's poor quality has come under fire for its irregular texture. FIFA is facing severe backlash for charging exorbitant ticket prices for the tournament in the United States.

Article Title: FIFA World Cup: Spain equal Argentina's record with 36-game unbeaten run after late Belgium win to reach the semis
Article Text:
Mikel Merino's late goal secured Spain's World Cup semifinal place. This victory also matched Argentina's record for the second-longest unbeaten run. Spain now holds a 36-game streak without defeat in international football. (AP Photo)

Mikel Merino's dramatic 88th-minute winner against Belgium at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood on Friday night sent Spain into the World Cup semifinals and simultaneously equalled Argentina's record for the second-longest unbeaten run in men's international football history.Spain's 2-1 victory over Belgium means they have now gone 36 consecutive matches without a defeat, matching the run Argentina compiled between 2019 and 2022, a sequence that culminated in their World Cup triumph in Qatar. Only Italy's extraordinary 37-game unbeaten streak between 2018 and 2021 stands ahead of Spain in the all-time list.The record-equalling win was anything but straightforward. Spain took the lead through Fabián Ruiz in the 30th minute, only to be pegged back by Charles De Ketelaere's equaliser in the 41st minute, the first goal Spain had conceded in the entire 2026 World Cup, ending Unai Simón's historic clean-sheet streak. With Belgium pushing for a winner and Spain's grip on the match loosening, it took a moment of individual brilliance from the most unlikely of sources.Merino, introduced as a second-half substitute, latched onto a spilled Pau Cubarsí shot after Belgian goalkeeper Senne Lammens, who had replaced the injured and tearful Thibaut Courtois in the 71st minute could not hold on to it cleanly. Merino pounced and buried the rebound.SoFi Stadium erupted.It was the second time in this tournament that Merino had come off the bench to score a decisive late winner, having done exactly the same against Portugal in the Round of 16, nodding home in stoppage time to send Cristiano Ronaldo home in tears.Spain now face France in the semifinal in Arlington, Texas on Tuesday, which is a heavyweight European clash that will decide one finalist. The other semifinal pits Argentina against England.Italy's record of 37 games unbeaten is now just one match away. A win against France on Tuesday would see Spain stand at the top of that list with the Azzuri's.
Article Summary: Spain's 2-1 victory over Belgium means they have now gone 36 consecutive matches without a defeat. Victory also matched Argentina's record for the second-longest unbeaten run. Only Italy's extraordinary 37-game unbeaten streak between 2018 and 2021 stands ahead of Spain in the all-time list.

Article Title: Fans accuse Jay-Z of taking a swipe at Colin Kaepernick in explosive new freestyle
Article Text:
Jay-Z’s ‘Kaep’ line brings Colin Kaepernick and his 2019 NFL backlash right back (Images via Getty and Twitter/X)

Jay-Z's Target deal brought the Kaepernick conversation right back where he said it was done



Jay-Z went from wearing Kaepernick's jersey on 'SNL' to shaking the NFL's hand without telling him



Jay-Z dropped those Kaepernick bars on May 30, two days later, he announced the Target deal



Jay-Z said in a 2019 GQ interview that he was past kneeling and ready for "actionable items." Seven years later, the internet is still asking what those items were.On May 30, Jay-Z headlined the 2026 Roots Picnic in Philadelphia, opening with an a cappella freestyle that had hip-hop talking for weeks. He came out with a new afro, which is more than beats and features, just bars. He took shots at Drake, Nicki Minaj, Kanye West, Damon Dash, and others. Buried in those bars were two lines that have resurfaced now with fresh context, as reported by several X accounts:"You picking & choosing the politicking as usual""They digging deep for narratives, it's embarrassing, they running outta characters, had to bring back up Kaep again"The resurfaced lyrics hold depth because Jay-Z is already facing renewed criticism over his Target partnership tied to the 30th anniversary of “Reasonable Doubt.”In June 2026, Jay-Z announced a collector's edition re-release of his 1996 debut Reasonable Doubt, exclusive to Target, a retailer that has been under a nationwide boycott since February 2025 over its rollback of DEI commitments. The deal was timed around the album's 30th anniversary and Juneteenth.Boycott organizers were not pleased. According to Atlanta Black Star, Nekima Levy Armstrong, one of three Minnesota activists pressuring Target over its $2.1 billion pledge to Black communities following George Floyd's murder, questioned how Jay-Z could have missed the boycott entirely."Did you go to Target or did Target come to you? Did you not know that there is a boycott? Unless you're living under a rock, it's hard for me to see that he didn't know," Armstrong said.A second organizer, Jaylani Hussein, called the move a strategic distraction. "Target is doubling down on a failed strategy with Colin Kaepernick and bringing in Jay-Z. And I think it's a great sign for everybody who's been protesting and standing up against Target and boycotting Target," Hussein said, as reported by Atlanta Black Star.Colin Kaepernick last played an NFL game in January 2017. He had spent the 2016 season kneeling during the national anthem to protest police brutality and racial injustice, and no team signed him afterward. Many of his supporters, including Jay-Z, believed he was being blackballed. Jay-Z wore a Kaepernick jersey on "Saturday Night Live" in 2017 and even turned down a Super Bowl performance that same year, later rapping about it on Beyoncé's "Apeshit": "I said no to the Super Bowl: You need me, I don't need you. "Then in August 2019, he sat alongside NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell at Roc Nation's Manhattan headquarters and announced a multi-year partnership making Roc Nation the league's live music entertainment strategist. Kaepernick was not part of the deal and, according to reports, was not consulted beforehand in any meaningful way.Jay-Z confirmed at the press conference that he had spoken to Kaepernick before the announcement but declined to share details of that conversation. He told the room he was not Kaepernick's boss and therefore could not ask him to join anything. Kaepernick's then-partner Nessa Diab called it disgusting and said Jay-Z helped the NFL bury him.Former Carolina Panthers safety Eric Reid, the first player to join Kaepernick in kneeling, was more direct, he said Jay-Z's goal was to make millions by assisting the NFL in burying Kaepernick's career. As reported by HipHopDX in July 2025, Diab later alleged that Roc Nation took $5 million a year over five years specifically to help the NFL move beyond the controversy around teams' refusal to sign Kaepernick.The freestyle happened May 30 at the Roots Picnic. Jay-Z rapped about people digging up tired narratives and recycling Kaepernick's name. On June 1, preorders opened for his Reasonable Doubt 30th anniversary vinyl, exclusive to Target, a retailer under active boycott since February 2025 over its DEI rollback.The irony wrote itself. He called the Kaepernick conversation old news and then handed everyone a brand new reason to have it again. Kaepernick hasn't played a snap since 2016. Jay-Z just keeps giving people fresh material.
Article Summary: On May 30, Jay-Z headlined the 2026 Roots Picnic in Philadelphia. He opened with an a cappella freestyle that had hip-hop talking for weeks. He took shots at Drake, Nicki Minaj, Kanye West, Damon Dash, and others. Buried in those bars were two lines that have resurfaced now with fresh context.

Article Title: "I am just f******g crying": Amon-Ra St. Brown's fiancée gets emotional while reliving the Lions star's heartwarming proposal
Article Text:
Amon-Ra St. Brown's fiancée gets emotional while reliving the Lions' heartwarming proposal(Getty Images)

Brooklyn Adams shares the emotional moments before Amon-Ra St. Brown got down on one knee

Amon-Ra St. Brown's proposal to longtime girlfriend Brooklyn Adams has already won over NFL fans. Now, Adams has shared the emotional side of that special day. In a behind-the-scenes video posted after their engagement announcement, the Detroit Lions star's fiancée fought back tears as she slowly realized the surprise was leading to a marriage proposal. Her honest reaction quickly became the moment fans connected with the most.St. Brown and Adams recently announced their engagement with a joint Instagram post captioned "Hard launch." The carousel featured the Lions wide receiver proposing aboard a yacht surrounded by white flowers before the couple celebrated with family and close friends.A few days later, Adams gave fans a closer look at how the proposal unfolded. She shared a video from the day that documented the surprise from beginning to end. Instead of taking her directly to the proposal, St. Brown arranged a scavenger hunt filled with meaningful stops connected to their relationship. At first, Adams looked completely confused about what was happening.As the surprises continued, the emotions started taking over. “I woke up thinking it was just another day. What's happening? I am just crying.If I'm not getting engaged, then I'm just be f*****g crying. I would be pissed off."Adams said those words in the video she shared on social media while trying to make sense of the day. She laughed through her tears as she followed each clue, and with every stop, she became more convinced that something life-changing was waiting at the end. The final destination was a beautifully decorated yacht, where St. Brown got down on one knee and asked her to marry him. Adams immediately said yes as the couple embraced before celebrating with their loved ones.The proposal marked another milestone for a couple whose relationship began long before the NFL spotlight. St. Brown and Adams first met during their sophomore year at Servite High School in Anaheim, California. They started as friends before their friendship turned into a relationship that lasted through high school, college and years of long distance.When St. Brown starred at USC and later entered the NFL with the Detroit Lions, Adams stayed in California to complete nursing school. Despite the distance, they remained together. After graduating as a registered nurse, Adams moved to Michigan, where the couple started building their life together.Fans also got to know Adams through Netflix's “Receiver”, where she appeared alongside St. Brown during the 2023 NFL season. Away from football, she also helps lead the St. Brown Foundation, which supports youth literacy programs across Michigan.Their engagement announcement drew congratulatory messages from across the NFL, including Lions quarterback Jared Goff , Bears quarterback Caleb Williams and Falcons receiver Drake London. Actor Taylor Lautner also joined thousands of fans celebrating the couple.The engagement photos captured the moment St. Brown asked the question, but Adams' video revealed everything that came before it. Her tears, laughter and disbelief showed just how carefully St. Brown planned the surprise. More than anything, her emotional reaction explained why the proposal meant so much after nearly a decade together, giving fans a genuine look at one of the happiest moments in the couple's journey.
Article Summary: Detroit Lions wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown proposed to longtime girlfriend Brooklyn Adams on a yacht. Adams shared a behind-the-scenes video of the proposal that documented the surprise from beginning to end. Her honest reaction quickly became the moment fans connected with the most.

Article Title: Chiefs have Patrick Mahomes, Kenneth Walker III and a revenge mission: So why are they ranked so low?
Article Text:
Patrick Mahomes (Getty Images)

Will Patrick Mahomes be fully healthy and effective for the 2026 season?

What are the biggest problems facing the Chiefs beyond the Mahomes injury?

The Kansas City Chiefs are staring at a reality they have not faced in over a decade. After missing the playoffs last season following Patrick Mahomes ' torn ACL, Bleacher Report's Brent Sobleski ranked them 17th in an early 2026 power ranking, a striking fall for a franchise that spent years treating the AFC Championship as routine. The ranking reflects something deeper than just an injury, pointing instead to a roster that barely moved during the offseason and a division that is no longer rolling over for Kansas City.Patrick Mahomes is trending toward a Week 1 return, but that may not tell the full story. ESPN's Adam Schefter drew a line between playing and performing, warning that ACL recoveries often take far longer to fully manifest than the initial timetable suggests. "The real question will be not whether he plays, but how effective he'll be," Schefter said.That caveat matters enormously for a team whose entire offensive structure is built around Mahomes making plays that most quarterbacks simply cannot. Sobleski echoed the concern, noting that the Chiefs are "entering a campaign after not making the playoffs thanks to a non-winning season" and that "the timetable for his return remains up in the air."Kansas City did add Justin Fields via trade as an insurance option, a former first-round pick who can step in if Mahomes is unavailable or limited early in the year.The injury is the headline, but the roster situation underneath it is arguably the more pressing concern heading into 2026. Kansas City made minimal moves to address the weaknesses that surfaced throughout last season. "From a roster standpoint, Kansas City isn't significantly better today than it was a year ago," Sobleski wrote. The addition of running back Kenneth Walker III should help take pressure off the passing game, but it does not resolve the issues at wide receiver.Rashee Rice, the team's most productive pass-catcher, reported to camp under a cloud after being jailed for 30 days to serve a sentence tied to his felony street-racing conviction, a punishment that came earlier than anticipated after a failed drug test. That kind of off-field instability around a skill-position starter is the last thing the Chiefs need while working through a Mahomes recovery. Sobleski was direct in his assessment: "This squad has a lot to prove and shouldn't be viewed as a Super Bowl contender. "The AFC West has also grown more competitive. Denver and Los Angeles are both building with momentum, while the Las Vegas Raiders just reshaped their identity around rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza. Kansas City can no longer rely on division games as a soft landing. As Sobleski put it, "Kansas City must first prove it's capable of returning to the postseason."
Article Summary: The Kansas City Chiefs are ranked 17th in an early 2026 power ranking. The ranking reflects something deeper than just an injury, pointing instead to a roster that barely moved during the offseason. The AFC West is no longer rolling over for Kansas City.

Article Title: Julian Edelman makes a perfect Rob Gronkowski comparison while praising Erling Haaland's FIFA World Cup run
Article Text:
Julian Edelman makes a perfect Rob Gronkowski comparison while praising Erling Haaland's FIFA World Cup run(Getty)

Julian Edelman compares Erling Haaland to Rob Gronkowski during FIFA World Cup praise

Erling Haaland has become one of the biggest stories of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The Norway striker has powered his country into the quarterfinals with another string of dominant performances. Every match has added to the growing belief that he is one of the most complete forwards in world football.His latest display has now sparked praise from an unexpected corner of the sports world. A former NFL star offered a comparison that immediately caught fans' attention because it perfectly summed up why Haaland has looked almost impossible to stop throughout the tournament.While speaking to Yahoo Sports, former New England Patriots wide receiver Julian Edelman compared Erling Haaland to Rob Gronkowski. “That dude's full European Gronk. He's European Gen Z Gronk.”Julian Edelman was not talking about statistics. He pointed to Haaland's rare physical presence and the way he overwhelms defenders. At around 6-foot-4, the Manchester City striker combines size, speed and strength in a way very few players can match.That comparison also explains why Haaland has become such a difficult player to defend. Norway reached the FIFA World Cup quarterfinals after beating Brazil 2-1 in the Round of 16 on July 5.Haaland once again led the attack as Norway pulled off one of the tournament's biggest upsets.Rob Gronkowski built his NFL career in much the same way. During his time with the Patriots and later the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, he used his size and athleticism to create mismatches every week. The four-time Super Bowl champion finished his career with 92 touchdown receptions and established himself as one of the greatest tight ends in league history.Haaland creates similar problems on the soccer field. Defenders know where he wants to go, but stopping him remains another challenge. His movement inside the penalty area, powerful runs and clinical finishing have turned him into one of the world's most feared strikers.His club career supports that reputation as well. Since joining Manchester City in 2022, Haaland has won the UEFA Champions League , multiple Premier League titles and several individual awards. He has continued to score at an extraordinary rate for both club and country.Haaland's impact goes beyond goals. Every defense adjusts its shape because of the threat he brings. His runs stretch the back line, his strength creates space and his presence gives Norway confidence in big moments. That is exactly why Edelman's comparison struck a chord. Both Haaland and Rob Gronkowski force opponents to rethink their entire game plan before kickoff.Julian Edelman's comparison landed because it focused on something fans instantly recognize. Both Rob Gronkowski and Erling Haaland dominate with a rare blend of power, athleticism and consistency. As Norway prepares to face England on July 11, Haaland has another chance to prove why the comparison feels so fitting.
Article Summary: Julian Edelman compares Erling Haaland to Rob Gronkowski during FIFA World Cup praise. The former New England Patriots wide receiver was speaking to Yahoo Sports. The Manchester City striker has become one of the biggest stories of the 2026 World Cup. Norway will face England in the quarterfinals.

Article Title: Did Tom Brady use his insider Patriots knowledge to help Seahawks defeat New England in Super Bowl LX? Here's what we know
Article Text:
Did Tom Brady help Seahawks beat Patriots in Super Bowl? (Getty Images)

Did Tom Brady help Seahawks beat Patriots in Super Bowl?

Who was the mystery adviser if it wasn't Tom Brady?

The speculation has been loud, and it wasn't entirely without reason. When Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald told Dan Patrick that someone with a "conflict of interest" helped him prepare for the New England Patriots ahead of Super Bowl LX -- a game Seattle won 29-13 -- fans immediately pointed at Tom Brady. The connections were real: Brady's Michigan ties to Macdonald, his history with New England's system, his role in pushing the Raiders toward Seahawks offensive coordinator Klint Kubiak. But WEEI's Zach Gelb reached out to Macdonald directly, and the answer was clear: it wasn't Brady.The speculation began during Macdonald's appearance on The Dan Patrick Show. While discussing the run to Seattle's Super Bowl victory, he acknowledged that several people had shared valuable advice before the game.“John Harbaugh and I talked. He was great,“ Macdonald said. ”I probably can’t mention one guy that really helped us out that had some conflict of interest."When Dan Patrick guessed whether the mystery figure was former Patriots coach Bill Belichick, Macdonald quickly ruled that out.“I’m not that cool,” Macdonald said. “I’ve had a beer with coach Belichick and that was pretty cool.”Although Patrick never mentioned Brady during the interview, many fans did.Brady's ties to both organizations made the theory sound believable. Beyond his legendary career with New England, he is now a minority owner of the Raiders, a franchise that recently hired former Seahawks offensive coordinator Klint Kubiak as its head coach. Brady also shares Michigan connections with Macdonald, adding another layer to the online discussion.The speculation spread rapidly, with some Patriots supporters openly questioning Brady's loyalty.“If this doesn’t piss you off as a Patriots fan you are dead on [the] inside,” noted Patriots fan Dave Portnoy said on X. “I’m not going to say who they are saying gave a ton of advice to the Seahawks before the Super Bowl but the guy has a statue in front of our stadium. What a joke.”The mystery remains unsolved, but one name has officially been crossed off the list.According to WEEI's Zach Gelb, Macdonald personally clarified the situation after the interview."I reached out to Mike Macdonald to get clarification on his comments on the @dpshow. I asked if @TomBrady was the person with the “conflict of interest” that gave input to the Seahawks before the Super Bowl. Mike told me it wasn’t Brady that he was talking about in the interview," Gelb posted on X.That clarification answers the biggest question surrounding the story, but it leaves another one behind. If neither Brady nor Belichick was involved, the identity of the mystery adviser remains unknown.For now, Macdonald appears content to leave it that way. Without additional details, there is little more than speculation, and the online theories that dominated discussion after his interview no longer have Brady at their center. Unless Macdonald chooses to reveal the person's identity in the future, the mystery is likely to remain one of the more intriguing side stories from Seattle's Super Bowl triumph.
Article Summary: Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald told Dan Patrick that someone with a "conflict of interest" helped him prepare for the New England Patriots. Fans immediately pointed at Tom Brady, but Macdonald said it wasn't him. The mystery remains unsolved, but one name has officially been crossed off.

Rice missed part of the 2025 season after suffering a concussion. Earlier this offseason, he was also ordered to serve 30 days in county jail after reportedly violating probation by testing positive for THC. He was also investigated in connection with another alleged assault involving a photographer.Palacios also noted that Kansas City has younger receivers waiting for larger roles. Players like Jalen Royals, Nikko Remigio and Cyrus Allen could push for more snaps during the season. If they continue to develop, the Chiefs may feel comfortable moving forward without Rice after his contract expires.According to Spotrac, Rice signed a four-year, $6.49 million rookie contract after the Chiefs selected him in the second round of the 2023 NFL Draft. He carries a $2.06 million cap hit in 2026 and is set to earn $1.56 million in base salary along with a $75,000 workout bonus. Rice will become an unrestricted free agent after the season.If Kansas City decides not to extend him, trading him before free agency could help the franchise recover draft assets instead of risking losing him without compensation.For the Dallas Cowboys, Rice would give Dak Prescott another dynamic receiver alongside CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens. The Chargers have invested in young receivers, but adding Rice would give the passing game more experience and depth.For the Baltimore Ravens, Rice could strengthen Lamar Jackson's receiving corps if the team decides it needs another proven playmaker alongside Zay Flowers.Nothing has been confirmed by the Chiefs, and there is no indication that trade talks are underway. Still, with Rice entering the final year of his rookie deal, his future in Kansas City is likely to remain a topic of discussion throughout the 2026 season.

Article Title: The truth behind Taylor Swift's wedding trash that sold out in 24 hours
Article Text:
Image - New Heights Podcast

An artist sold 50 cubes of trash from Taylor Swift's wedding, and Swifties bought every single one



"I made 50. I call it 'Pocket Garbage,' $25 each,"

"manifesting something for the couple."

Why Swifties will buy literally anything with her name attached



Nothing says "true fan" quite like paying $25 for a stranger's cigarette butt, but that's exactly what happened after Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce 's wedding at Madison Square Garden. Queens-based artist Justin Gignac suited up in a tuxedo, grabbed a claw picker, and combed the streets outside MSG for leftover trash the night of the July 3 ceremony. He sealed his finds into 50 tiny clear cubes, listed them online for $25 each, and sold out within 24 hours.Gignac, who's been running his "New York City Garbage" project since 2001, wasn't shy about the concept.he told CBS New York, adding that bigger cubes of "regular garbage" go for $100.His haul included cigarette butts, bottle caps, caution tape, a lone AirPod, a Ring Pop, and the crown jewel, an ovulation test kit, which he joked might beHe was careful to clarify he collected everything from public streets outside the security perimeter, not from inside the actual reception, so no, that's not literally Selena Gomez 's gum wrapper. Didn't matter. The listing, titled "NYC Pocket Garbage: Not Invited Edition," went live July 8 and was gone within a day, buyers scattered across roughly 30 countries.This isn't Gignac's first rodeo turning trash into a moment, he's sold over 1,700 cubes since he started, commemorating everything from Obama's inauguration to the Yankees' 2009 World Series win, so the wedding drop was really just his latest "cultural snapshot."But the frenzy says more about Swiftie culture than it does about Gignac's hustle. This is a fanbase that once bid $7,000 for a chair Swift merely sat in at an NBA game, so a $25 cube promising "a piece of the greatest day of their lives" was never going to be a hard sell.And Gignac wasn't the only one capitalizing, a separate listing offered a bag of "MSG air" allegedly captured from inside the venue, priced at nearly $50,000. Somewhere out there, a Swiftie is currently displaying a sealed bag of cigarette-butt-adjacent air next to their Eras Tour ticket stub, and honestly? Iconic behavior.
Article Summary: Queens-based artist Justin Gignac combed the streets outside Madison Square Garden for leftover trash. He sealed his finds into 50 tiny clear cubes, listed them online for $25 each, and sold out within 24 hours. Swifties will buy literally anything with her name attached.

Article Title: Zohran Mamdani defends Taylor Swift's wedding as Republicans question $160K NYPD security costs
Article Text:

Zohran Mamdani confirms Taylor Swift, not taxpayers, covered wedding police costs



"Taylor Swift has paid already the cost of the permit that was lodged, which was over $160,000 for that event and for the response to that event,"

"taxpayers are subsidizing Taylor Swift's love life"

Why this became a political flashpoint in the first place



Turns out love is expensive, but so are a hundred-plus NYPD officers on overtime, and Taylor Swift picked up that tab herself. NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani confirmed on Friday that Swift paid the city over $160,000 to cover the police permit and security response for her wedding to Travis Kelce at Madison Square Garden. The clarification comes after Republicans publicly questioned whether taxpayers would end up footing the bill for the star-studded event.Asked directly whether Swift would reimburse the city for police overtime, Mamdani didn't hesitate.he said, adding the permit was finalized just days before the wedding itself. The $160K covered the city permit required for street closures and traffic management around MSG, plus the NYPD's beefed-up presence for the weekend.The wedding, which took place across July 2–3, pulled in more than 1,000 guests including Paul McCartney , Stevie Nicks , Ciara and Fergie, who all performed at the ceremony. Streets around Madison Square Garden were shut down, NDAs were reportedly mandatory, and phones were banned at the door. So basically, a level of security you'd expect for a head of state, not a pop star's wedding. Given the wedding's estimated eight-figure price tag, $160,000 is genuinely pocket change for Swift, but the confirmation matters politically, it kills thenarrative before it could spiral.This wasn't just a stray question, it came after Republicans raised a stink about who'd be covering NYPD overtime for a private billionaire's wedding, especially with Mamdani, a democratic socialist, in the mayor's seat.The irony of "Communist Mamdani" personally defending a billionaire pop star's expenditure wasn't lost on anyone, and clips of him fielding the question have been making the rounds.Mamdani also used the moment to point out that NYC's summer has been unusually packed with big events, whether it's the Knicks' first championship in 53 years, the FIFA World Cup, or America's 250th birthday, meaning the city's had to get selective about what it says yes to. Swift's wedding, apparently, made the cut, and now it's made her bank account $160,000 lighter too. Small price for eternal love (and Paul McCartney as your wedding singer).

The $160K covered the city permit required for street closures and traffic management around MSG, plus the NYPD's beefed-up presence for the weekend. The wedding, which took place across July 2–3, pulled in more than 1,000 guests.
